HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09 requires temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement [E1]. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. This bulletin does not change the approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment [E1].

Operational guidance for hepatic monitoring includes:
*   If ALT/AST is >3x ULN, a Medical review is required [E2].
*   If Bilirubin is >2x ULN, an Urgent review is required [E2].
*   If there is a Mild isolated change (below trigger), a Repeat test is required [E2].
